title: Over 5.6% voted in advance as of Wednesday in Latvia
summary_full: During the first three days, over 83,000 people took the opportunity to cast their votes in advance of the 15th Saema elections, and a further nearly 5,000 citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts as voter turnout, bringing the total to 5.66 per cent, LSM.lv reports.
